claim_type: scoped written proof with exact finite corroboration
result: For 0 < c < 1 and integer ranks, every fusion of paid child jobs strictly lowers the paid moment; a single fusion of ranks a,b saves D(a,b) with 0 < D(a,b) < min(a,b)^c and sharp constant one; at fixed total rank the balanced split maximizes D; any fusion scheme lowers the paid moment by at most G(c) = sum p^c - (sum p)^c, so a paid-only rewrite cannot push the crossing exponent past the root against one paid job of the total paid rank. No kappa change.
interpretation: A searching contributor can reject a whole paid-fusion family without a word replay: compute the root against one collapsed paid job; if it is below the target, no fusion scheme reaches the target.
limitations: Moment model only. No word, caller, compiler, precision tape or outer row is certified. The productive side is not bounded; #6651 gives the balanced-split optimum there.
